fire: Tape them to the wall. Or, you can staple them.
Cook until soft, or heat in the oven.
Go left at the fork; or go right along the cliff.
Glue it down. Or, you can tie it.
Boil for ten minutes, or steam in the pot.
quiet: Tape them to the wall. Then wait.
Go left at the fork and stay on the cliff.
Glue it down. Then dry it.
Boil for ten minutes and cool in the pot.

notes: Probes were low (0.09-0.25), so a failure on strength is possible.
